headline: True positive attack: password spray led to mailbox access and managed identity token theft
summary: On 2026-07-17 23:09:23–23:09:24, source IP 185.220.101.34 conducted a password spray against three accounts, accessed m.fischer@contoso.com via Microsoft Graph, and obtained a managed identity token through IMDS on webapp-vm-001. Data access was confirmed.

items.title: Incident classified as true positive
items.detail: Incident Classification: True Positive; Incident Determination: Other.

items.title: Confirmed attack with data access
items.detail: The investigation states a confirmed attack progressed through Credential Access and Collection, and data access was confirmed.

items.title: Source IP
items.detail: Public IP observed as the attack source.

items.title: Password spray targeted three accounts
items.detail: 14 failed ROPC sign-ins targeted j.bauer, l.schneider, and m.fischer from 185.220.101.34.

items.title: Accounts targeted by spray
items.detail: The spray targeted j.bauer@contoso.com, l.schneider@contoso.com, and m.fischer@contoso.com.

items.title: Mailbox access confirmed
items.detail: Four Graph operations read three items each from m.fischer@contoso.com.

items.title: Affected mailbox
items.detail: m.fischer@contoso.com was targeted and accessed.

items.title: Managed identity token obtained via IMDS
items.detail: IMDS issued an Azure Resource Manager token from webapp-vm-001 using curl/8.5.0.

items.title: Affected virtual machine
items.detail: webapp-vm-001 hosted the IMDS request.

items.title: Compromised managed identity
items.detail: Managed identity 11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555 is listed as compromised.

items.title: T1110.003 — Password Spraying
items.detail: Credential guessing across multiple accounts through ROPC.

items.title: T1114.002 — Remote Email Collection
items.detail: Mailbox items collected through Microsoft Graph.

items.title: T1552.005 — Cloud Instance Metadata API
items.detail: Managed identity token obtained from IMDS.

items.title: Password spray event
items.detail: 14 failed ROPC sign-ins targeted j.bauer, l.schneider, and m.fischer from 185.220.101.34.

items.title: Graph mailbox read event
items.detail: Four Graph operations read three items each from m.fischer@contoso.com.

items.title: IMDS token issuance event
items.detail: IMDS issued an Azure Resource Manager token from webapp-vm-001 using curl/8.5.0.

items.title: Correlated alert: Password Spray from Tor Exit Node
items.detail: True Positive with evidence of 14 failed sign-ins targeting 3 accounts.

items.title: Correlated alert: Rapid Mailbox Enumeration via Graph API
items.detail: True Positive with evidence of 12 mailbox items read across four operations.

items.title: Correlated alert: Unusual metadata service access
items.detail: True Positive with evidence that a managed identity token was obtained through IMDS.

items.title: Additional targeted accounts
items.detail: j.bauer@contoso.com and l.schneider@contoso.com were targeted by the spray.

items.title: Client application
items.detail: Observed client application: outlook-client-app-id.

items.title: Reset targeted credentials and revoke sessions
items.detail: Reset targeted account credentials, revoke sessions, and enforce phishing-resistant MFA.

items.title: Review mailbox and Graph exposure
items.detail: Review Graph consent, mailbox audit history, forwarding rules, and accessed finance content.

items.title: Isolate VM and rotate managed identity path
items.detail: Isolate webapp-vm-001, rotate the managed identity path, and determine how IMDS became reachable.
